name: Tupalo

sources.title: Tupalo Business FAQ — basic listing free but verification costs 12 EUR / 5 years; Premium upgrade exists
Business owner sign-up page linking to 'Add your business' spot flow (via search snippet; tupalo.com 403s direct fetches)
Yext publisher page — required fields: Address, Categories, Main Phone, Name; Europe-focused local review community

conditions: Basic business listing is free but 'needs to be verified' — verification carries a 12 EUR / 5-year fee per the FAQ
Community members can add 'spots' for free without verification, but that is an unclaimed user-added spot, not an owner listing
Business owner account required for the managed-listing route (tupalo.com/en/bizusers/sign_up)
requirements: This is a LOCAL business directory (Europe-heavy): required fields per Yext integration are Name, Address, Categories, Main Phone — a pure online SaaS with no physical location is a poor fit
Real address with map pin (their add flow places a marker on a map)
preparation: Business name, street address, postal code, city
Main phone number and website URL
workflow: Sign up for a Tupalo Business Owner account at /en/bizusers/sign_up
Use 'Add your business' (/en/api/v5/spot/new or the spot add flow) and drop the map pin on the address
Fill required fields: name, address, categories, main phone
Submit; listing appears as a 'spot' page
Optionally pay 12 EUR/5yr verification or upgrade to Premium for extra features
watchFor: tupalo.com 403s automated fetches — expect bot friction
Two interfaces: consumer site (tupalo.com) vs business portal (tupalo.biz) — links cross between them
Verification is a small recurring fee, not truly free
Adding a HQ-less SaaS as a 'local business' may be rejected or look spammy — fit is genuinely local-business only
countsAsLive: The business appears as a public spot page on tupalo.com with address, phone, and category, searchable in its city
unknowns: Whether unverified free listings stay live indefinitely
Dofollow status of the website field
